newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge higher in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge higher in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks gained slightly in early morning on Monday, as the yen's sharp decline against the dollar inspired some buying of export-oriented issues, although shares in the troubled financial sector remained weak, brokers said.

At 0034 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was up 47.11 points or 0.25 percent at 18,659.97. June Nikkei futures rose 40 points to 18,670. "Today is between holidays and there were no active attempts to test higher levels," said a broker at a medium-sized securities house. Japan's markets will be closed on Tuesday for a national holiday.
Trading was also subdued as the market warily eyed currency movements after Sunday's Group of Seven (G7) meeting, brokers said.
